cards.name: 蚊帳
cards.scene: A bed covered by a white translucent mosquito net, a child sleeping peacefully inside, two or three small mosquitoes outside the net unable to get in.

cards.name: 非洲
cards.scene: The simple shape of the African continent filled in warm orange-yellow, with a cute giraffe and a flat-topped acacia tree standing beside it. No map labels, no country borders.

cards.name: 瘧疾
cards.scene: A child lying in bed with a fever, flushed cheeks, a cold towel on the forehead, a small red bite mark on the arm, a mosquito flying away. The child looks unwell but calm, not scary.

cards.name: 募集
cards.scene: Several children standing around a big plain unmarked cardboard box, other children lining up and putting teddy bears, balls and folded clothes into the box. The box is completely plain brown with nothing printed on it.

cards.name: 捐贈
cards.scene: A child handing a wrapped gift package with both hands to a smiling adult who receives it gratefully.

cards.name: 獎狀
cards.scene: A happy child proudly hugging a rolled-up award certificate scroll tied with a red ribbon and a shiny gold star medal, little confetti around. The paper is rolled up so no surface of the paper is visible.

cards.name: 收藏
cards.scene: A child carefully placing a special seashell into an open wooden treasure box that is neatly filled with collected seashells, pebbles and small leaves.

cards.name: 雜誌
cards.scene: A child sitting on the floor happily reading a magazine held up in front of them, seen from the front so we only see the magazine's back cover, which is one plain solid light-blue color with nothing on it. A small stack of magazines beside the child, seen from the side, plain colored edges only.

cards.name: 基金會
cards.scene: Several friendly adults sitting around a meeting table working together, a big red heart floating above them, a piggy bank and boxes of supplies on the table, symbolizing an organization that helps others.

cards.name: 全力以赴
cards.scene: A child running a relay race with all their strength, leaning forward, holding a relay baton tightly in one hand, arms pumping, drops of sweat, a confident determined face with clenched teeth (not scared, not crying).

cards.name: 驚慌失措
cards.scene: A child with both hands on the head, wide eyes and open mouth, a knocked-over cup of water at their feet, small panic lines around them.

cards.name: 聚精會神
cards.scene: A child leaning over a desk, looking very carefully and quietly through a magnifying glass at a green leaf, fully focused.

cards.name: 一筆一畫
cards.scene: Close-up of a child's hand holding a pencil, slowly and carefully drawing one straight stroke on a sheet of empty square grid paper. The grid squares are empty except for that one line.

cards.name: 喜不自禁
cards.scene: A child jumping up with both arms raised, a beaming smile with curved happy eyes, only little yellow stars and small confetti dots around. No medals, no badges, no signs.

cards.name: 夢想成真
cards.scene: A child standing in front of a glowing open door; through the door is a bright green meadow with a rainbow, the same scene as in the child's crayon drawing held in one hand. The child spreads arms in delighted surprise.

cards.name: 大聲疾呼
cards.scene: A child standing on a low wooden platform, both hands cupped around the mouth, calling out loudly with visible sound-wave lines, classmates turning to listen. A plain green trash bin beside the platform. Plain white background behind them: no banner, no poster, no board, no sign.

cards.name: 死灰復燃
cards.scene: A camping barbecue grill with a pile of grey ashes, and in the middle a small flame flickering back to life; a child nearby pointing at it in surprise.

cards.name: 碩果僅存
cards.scene: A completely bare tree in late autumn with no leaves at all; the whole tree has only ONE single big red apple left, hanging at the very top branch. Many fallen leaves and apples on the ground. A small child looking up at that one last apple.

cards.name: 集思廣益
cards.scene: Four children sitting around a round table, each child has one small glowing light bulb floating above their own head (four small bulbs), and above the center of the table floats one big bright glowing light bulb made from their ideas combined.

cards.name: 寄人籬下
cards.scene: A child holding a small suitcase standing shyly at the bamboo fence gate of a relative's simple house, an adult relative at the door kindly waving. The house walls are plain with no plaques, no signs, no decorations. Gentle and warm mood, not sad.

cards.name: 赴湯蹈火
cards.scene: A brave firefighter in full gear running toward a smoking house holding a fire hose, determined expression.

cards.name: 蚊香
cards.scene: A green coiled mosquito-repellent incense burning on a small metal stand, a thin wisp of smoke rising, a mosquito flying away from the smoke.

cards.name: 皺紋
cards.scene: Close-up of a kind smiling grandmother with gentle wrinkle lines on her forehead and around her eyes.

cards.name: 帳篷
cards.scene: A cloth camping tent pitched on green grass, two children happily peeking out from the tent entrance.

cards.name: 脹氣
cards.scene: A child holding a round, swollen tummy with both hands after eating too much, puffed cheeks, an uncomfortable face, an empty big plate beside.

cards.name: 惆悵
cards.scene: A child standing at a window watching a friend's car drive away, looking a little sad and lost, one hand resting on the window glass.

cards.name: 虐待
cards.scene: A sad, thin, dirty puppy tied to a pole with a very short rope next to an empty bowl, looking mistreated; a kind child kneeling to comfort it. Gentle mood, not scary, no blood, no injuries.

cards.name: 叮咬
cards.scene: A mosquito biting a child's arm, a small red itchy bump on the skin, the child frowning and about to scratch.

cards.name: 盯著
cards.scene: A cat sitting perfectly still, staring intently with wide eyes at a small bird outside a window.

cards.name: 日暮
cards.scene: A sunset over a small village, the sun half hidden behind the hills, orange and pink sky, a child walking home with a school bag.

cards.name: 布幕
cards.scene: A small theater stage with big red velvet curtains closing at the end of a show, children in the audience clapping.

cards.name: 羨慕
cards.scene: A child looking with admiring, longing eyes at a classmate who is playing a shiny violin beautifully.

cards.name: 增加
cards.scene: A child happily adding coins into a clear glass jar, the pile of coins in the jar growing higher and higher.

cards.name: 憎恨
cards.scene: A child frowning angrily with crossed arms and a small dark storm cloud above the head, looking at a broken toy robot on the floor. Mild, not scary.

cards.name: 僧侶
cards.scene: A Buddhist monk in plain grey robes with a shaved head, sitting calmly in a simple temple hall with palms pressed together, peaceful.

cards.name: 豆漿
cards.scene: A glass of warm white soy milk next to a small bowl of yellow soybeans on a breakfast table, a child about to drink it.

cards.name: 果醬
cards.scene: A plain glass jar of red strawberry jam with no label, a spoon, and a slice of toast being spread with jam, fresh strawberries beside.

cards.name: 船槳
cards.scene: A child sitting in a small wooden rowboat on a calm lake, holding two wooden oars and rowing.

cards.name: 形狀
cards.scene: A child fitting colorful wooden blocks of different shapes (circle, square, triangle, star) into the matching holes of a shape-sorter box.

cards.name: 強壯
cards.scene: A strong, healthy child proudly lifting a pair of dumbbells, showing arm muscles with a confident smile.

cards.name: 寶藏
cards.scene: An open wooden treasure chest overflowing with gold coins and jewels, half buried in a sandy beach, a small shovel beside it.
